title: Value of Aggregators
eligible_reason: Single-date event: the American Airlines-Orbitz dispute removed AA fares from Orbitz for all consumers at the same time (disp = months 1-5, disp_treatment = disp x year 2011). Individual-domain browsing regressions (xtreg, fe) compare dispute months in 2011 with the same months in 2010/2012, with ad-spend controls and domain interactions; DB1B fare regressions are IV. Not a staggered design; treatment also switches off after five months.
design_notes: Stata xtreg fe (machine-id x domain panel of comScore browsing), R plm, MATLAB likelihood (purchase model, Table 17), ivreghdfe on DB1B route data (Tables 18-19). Treatment window common to all units.

specs.exclusion_reason: common dispute window (single adoption date), switches off; time-varying ad-spend control tot_exp; domain-by-dispute interactions

data_files_note: Code Readme: 'All browsing files are samples: code will run on these files, but will not replicate tables. Please purchase data directly from comScore.' DB1B and fuel-cost inputs are public.
data_provenance_note: comScore browsing data shipped only as samples with no stated random sampling rule (do not replicate tables); counts as not_shipped.
software_notes: Stata (xtreg, ivreghdfe), R (data construction), MATLAB (purchase model)
screener_notes: Screened from package only (no article text or PDF). Single common event; not staggered; comScore data samples only.
